subject.title: fix(reef): contain startup friend reconcile failures

question: Should Reef activate after a retryable startup friend-reconcile failure and temporarily use persisted peer keys, rather than fail startup until reconciliation succeeds?
rationale: The code and tests can establish ordering and containment, but they cannot choose the intended availability-versus-stale-peer delivery policy for a relay outage.

options.title: Accept degraded startup
options.body: Merge the shared lifecycle policy so retryable relay failures report, activate with persisted peers, and retry on the next interval.

options.title: Keep fail-fast startup
options.body: Require successful startup reconciliation and retain the current account-restart behavior for all startup failures.

options.title: Narrow the retryable set
options.body: Permit only explicitly approved transient statuses at startup and keep the rest fail-fast with corresponding tests.

recommendation.title: Accept degraded startup
recommendation.body: Merge the shared lifecycle policy so retryable relay failures report, activate with persisted peers, and retry on the next interval.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the related Reef recovery design, has recent history in the lifecycle path, and is assigned to this PR.
